annotations.title: Ask to connect to other servers

description: Ask the operator of the installation to let a lambda's code connect to other servers - call an API with HttpClient, open a socket, a WebSocket or mail client - or read where that stands. Without it, code that connects does not compile (LAMBDA0003); a premium lambda may anyway, and read_lambda says connectivity.allowed. Ask only where the server has to make the call - a key that must not reach the browser, an API browsers may not call - and fetch a public API from the lambda's page otherwise. Say what it connects to and why. The operator decides, which takes a while: tell the user it was asked, and build what does not connect meanwhile. withdraw: true takes the request back, or gives up what was allowed - only when the user asks. With only privateKey it returns where it stands.

purpose.description: What it connects to and why, for the operator who decides: the addresses or services and what the lambda does with them - 'api.stripe.com, to take payments for the shop', not 'HTTP calls'. Needed to ask; left out, it returns where it stands.

withdraw.description: Take the request back, or give up what was allowed - code that connects then no longer compiles. Only when the user asks.
